conventions.tnt_kg: kg of TNT equivalent (blast). War Thunder rows: explosiveMass x explosiveTypes[type].strengthEquivalent from gamedata/damage_model/explosive.blkx - the same number War Thunder displays as "TNT equivalent" (check: 3OF26 3.402 kg A-IX-2 x 1.54 = 5.24 kg, matching the WT wiki).
conventions.kinetic: APFSDS/APDS/APCR/AP-T/ball/incendiary rounds without an HE filler have tnt_kg 0.
conventions.cluster: cluster casing rows = 0; #bomblet rows carry the per-bomblet value.
conventions.confidence: high = direct WT/official figure for that exact munition; medium = variant proxy or secondary source; low = estimate
